settings.scopeNotice: Per-type notifications and do-not-disturb hours apply only to {teams}. In-app (bell) notifications are always shown.
settings.notifyQaDesc: Get notified when a QA is created, changes status, or is assigned
settings.notifyCommentDesc: Get notified when someone comments on a QA you're assigned to
settings.notifyReplyDesc: Get notified when someone replies to your comment
settings.quietHoursDesc: Teams notifications are muted during these hours (in-app notifications still appear)
settings.quietHoursHint: If the end time is earlier than the start, the range wraps past midnight (e.g. 22:00 ~ 08:00).
settings.teamsMasterDesc: Get 1:1 notifications in your Teams (master switch)
settings.botInstallTitle: Install the Teams bot to receive notifications
settings.botStep1: In Teams, go to {apps} → {manageApps} → {uploadApp} and add the QA Manager bot.
settings.botStep2: Once a 1:1 chat with the bot opens, the install is complete.
settings.botStep3: Use {testSend} below to verify the connection.
settings.botInstallFootnote: Notifications are not delivered until the bot is installed. Ask your admin for help with installation.
settings.testRequiresEnabled: Turn on Teams notifications to send a test.

teams.sentSuccess: Test message sent. Check your Teams.
